page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 24 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, providing 24 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, and a bottom 10% result in single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, with middle 50% scores in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 984.37 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 96.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

Given its high memory density and average multi-core processing capabilities, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded performance. Appropriate applications include database operations, Redis caching, and multi-threaded data processing. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which should be factored into the overall resource architecture. The instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large memory footprints without the premium cost of high-frequency single-core compute.
